policy: Task stages describe this workstream deliverable, not overall game acceptance. Art-only tasks may be tested as assets but require integration and rendered acceptance before visual acceptance. Existing code-only verification remains open. Dependencies are ready at tested, visually verified or accepted stage; final acceptance requires the controlling release gates. Browser is conservatively a shared resource, not a guarantee of available slots. Keep unless a demonstrated defect, unmet mandatory product outcome or validated player-experience issue warrants a change. Verify existing work first; do not invent new work solely to increase progress counts. Optional refinements should not delay release after required gates pass. Manual continue/resume/proceed targets three distinct actionable workstreams per session, subject to resource leases, dependencies, verification and session limits; see AGENTS.md. Issue #2 and the owner-approved HUD/camera refinements are release-critical: prioritize independently actionable painted room integration, coherent first frames, bounded camera/door transitions and HUD legibility before optional feature expansion; respect active leases and existing dependencies. Do not count backlog edits as implementation.
